text: Fiery the angels fell; deep thunder rolled around their shores; burning with the fires of Orc.
author: Ridley Scott
visual_brief: A precise astronomical engineering drawing of an open parabolic radio telescope array tilted upward toward deep space. Fine orthographic projection lines, focal point construction rays, and vector arrows track high-energy particle cascades descending across the dark field into the receiver horn.
alt: Technical white line schematic of a deep-space radio dish receiving cosmic rays
